9 kg/m2
  -  Male  [OR] or female
  -  Physically active (> 3 x 30 min moderate exercise per week)
  -  Non-smoker (including the use of vaporisers  [OR] and e-cigarettes)
  -  Healthy (determined by the School's standard health questionnaire)
  -  No cardiometabolic  [OR] or inflammatory illness
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Outside of age-range
  -  Outside BMI range
  -  Inactive (< 3 x 30 min moderate exercise per week)
  -  Smoker
  -  Taking medication
  -  History of cardiometabolic  [OR] or inflammatory illness
  -  Vegetarian/ [OR]  vegan (as the high-fat diet is based on animal fats)
  -  Other dietary restrictions which prevent consumption of the experimental diet
  -  Consumption of probiotics within last 3 months (these influence the gut microbiota)
  -  Participation in another clinical trial
  -  Those with known  [OR] or suspected food intolerances, allergies  [OR] or hypersensitivity
  -  Women  [AND] who are known to be pregnant  [OR] or who are intending to become pregnant over the course of the study
